content.text: {"status":"ok","subject":"Science","questions":[{"q_text":"Differentiate between distance and displacement.","q_type":"difference","marks":4,"blocks":[{"type":"compare_table","headers":["Distance","Displacement"],"rows":[["It is the total path length covered by a moving body","It is the shortest straight line distance between start and end points"],["It is always positive","It can be positive, negative or zero"],["It has no direction (scalar quantity)","It has direction (vector quantity)"],["It can be equal to or greater than displacement","It can be equal to or less than distance"]]}],"keywords":["total path length","shortest straight line distance","scalar quantity","vector quantity"],"diagram":{"template":"path_vs_straight","params":{"path_length":10,"straight_length":6,"unit":"m"}},"unit_direction_note":"Distance has no direction, displacement has direction","concept_key":"c5-science-distance-vs-displacement","scene_prompt":"A child walking a curvy path in a park compared to walking straight across the grass."},{"q_text":"What is photosynthesis?","q_type":"short","marks":2,"blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants make their own food using sunlight, water and carbon dioxide, and release oxygen."}],"keywords":["green plants","sunlight","water","carbon dioxide","oxygen"],"diagram":null,"unit_direction_note":"","concept_key":"c5-science-photosynthesis","scene_prompt":"A green plant in sunlight with water being absorbed by its roots and leaves releasing oxygen."}]}
